messages:
alex: FYI noticed a perf regression after the infra team rolled driver 551.10 to prod last night. Short-sequence requests (<=32 tokens) are hitting a fallthrough kernel path and p95 token latency jumped ~40% on h2-small. Logs show kernel chooser preferring arch-aware-v2 for tiny batches.

priya: ugh. saw some KV-cache miss spikes around the same time on telemetry, possible correlation. do we have profiler traces? :eyes:

tom: I ran a lightweight perf-profiler on a canary replica with 551.10 and reproduced. autotuner now favors the long-seq kernel for seq<=32 when batch_size >= 4 (weird). snippet from chooser log:```INFO kernel_choice: seq=24 batch=4 arch=hopper pick=arch-aware-v2 score=0.82 fallback=shortpath-v1```

kelly: that pick is surprising. arch-aware-v2 has vector-width optimizations that underperform on small KV-cache hits due to poor kv-lookup alignment. profiler flamegraph shows stall on kv_lookup loop and higher L2 misses. attaching small paste of perf counters:```CPU:CYCLES 1.2M
L2_MISSES 12.4k
DRAM_READS 3.1k```

buildbot: production-alert: kernel-choice-anomaly threshold breached on cluster:edge-east-03 (p95_token_latency +42%).

alex: mitigation brainstorm: (A) rollback driver to 550.77 on a small canary set, (B) disable arch-aware autotune flag so chooser falls back to shortpath-v1 for seq<=64, (C) server-side rule: force shortpath kernel for batch<=8 & seq<=48. Thoughts?

priya: I'd prefer (B) + (C) as faster to deploy. rolling driver rollback takes longer and touches infra ops. we can patch runtime via feature flag: `RUNTIME_AUTOTUNE_ARCH_AWARE=false` and a per-route override for heavy long-seq workloads.

tom: agree. I'll push a canary of the flag to edge-east-03 and run the same perf smoke. command I'll run:```kubectl -n redwood set env deploy/runtime RUNTIME_AUTOTUNE_ARCH_AWARE=false --record```

kelly: when you push, please also enable KV-cache-prefetch logging at debug for 10m so we can confirm hitrate and alignment metrics. We'll monitor `kv.hitrate`, `kernel.choice.hist`, `p95_token_latency`. Thresholds to watch: p95 <= previous baseline, kv.hitrate >= 98%, kernel.choice shortpath% >= 90%.

buildbot: CI smoke finished: runtime-flag-canary passed unit tests, integration harness queued.

alex: action items: @tom run the flag canary and smoke perf (ETA 30m). @kelly enable kv-prefetch debug and collect traces. @priya prepare driver-rollback runbook in case flag rollback doesn't restore baseline. I'll coordinate comms with infra and ops. :thumbsup:

priya: added a short rollback runbook entry to the incident doc (link omitted). If canary fails we'll schedule driver reversion to 550.77 on one AZ and monitor for 1h before wider revert.

tom: canary done — initial numbers look promising: p95 dropped back to ~baseline and kernel.choice shows shortpath pick ~92% for the test distribution. I'll keep it running for 45m and dump traces.

kelly: collecting KV traces now. early signs confirm KV-cache hit rate recovered and L2 miss counts down ~60%. will post flamegraphs in ~20m.

alex: great. once we validate on canary we do a staged roll of the flag across regions and keep rollback plan ready. thanks team.
